descriptionByLocale.en:
Polymechanic in the field of erosion 80-100%, on site | Manufacture Horlogère Suisse | ETA SA
• Polymechanic in the field of erosion 80-100%, on site
• Your future areas of responsibility You will work in a team of 5-10 specialists and can fully contribute your know-how in
• programming, setting up and operating die-sinking erosion and wire erosion machines
• assembly and disassembly of injection molding tools
• production of mold inserts, individual components, replacement and wear parts for existing or new tools
• implementation of Maintenance work on injection molding tools
• Processing technical changes
• Technical collaboration in various projects relating to optimization and innovations
• Your skills and competenciesCompleted training as a polymechanic / toolmaker
• Professional experience in the field of tool making and erosion
• Experience in the field of plastics technology is an advantage
• “Doer” personality with a sense for efficient and innovative solutions
• Enthusiasm for your specialist area, work in the 1000th range and for modern technologies
• Skilled, reliable, able to work in a team and under pressure
• Great personal commitment, flexibility and independence
• Willingness to work in 2 shifts in special cases
• Apply
• LanguagesYou have good knowledge of German
• This is what you can expect from usAn exciting working environment in a company that is constantly developing and offers numerous advantages:
• Diverse opportunities for further training
• Internal mobility with attractive career prospects
• Five or six weeks of vacation per year (depending on age and/or function)
• 40-hour week in accordance with the CBA
• Attractive wage policy and good social benefits
• Three weeks of parental leave for fathers and up to 19 weeks for mothers
• Company restaurant
• Discounts on products from the Swatch Group and other partner companies
• Sports activities and company events
• Participation in health insurance
• Where you can find usETA SA Manufacture Horlogère Suisse
• 2540 Grenchen
• Good accessibility by public transport
• Ready for the next step? Tell us what excites you. We look forward to receiving your complete application!
• Please apply exclusively online via our website – for the sake of the environment and to ensure efficient processing.
• Susanna Fullin
